title: A+B
description: Read two integers and print their sum.
inputDescription: The first line contains two integers a and b.

title: Four Operations
description: Read two integers and print their sum, difference, product, and integer quotient on separate lines.
inputDescription: The first line contains two positive integers a and b. b is not zero.
outputDescription: Print a+b, a-b, a*b, and a/b using integer division.

title: Even or Odd
description: Read one integer and print EVEN if it is even, otherwise print ODD.
inputDescription: The first line contains one integer n.

title: Maximum of Three
description: Read three integers and print the largest value.
inputDescription: The first line contains three integers.

title: Sum 1 to N
description: Read n and print the sum of all integers from 1 to n.
inputDescription: The first line contains one positive integer n.

title: Multiplication Table
description: Read n and print n times 1 through 9.
inputDescription: The first line contains one integer n.
outputDescription: Print nine lines in the form n * i = result.

title: Countdown
description: Read n and print numbers from n down to 1.
inputDescription: The first line contains one positive integer n.
outputDescription: Print each number on its own line.

title: Array Sum
description: Read n integers and print their sum.
inputDescription: The first line contains n. The second line contains n integers.

title: Array Min Max
description: Read n integers and print the minimum and maximum values.
inputDescription: The first line contains n. The second line contains n integers.
outputDescription: Print min and max separated by one space.

title: Count Even Numbers
description: Read n integers and count how many are even.
inputDescription: The first line contains n. The second line contains n integers.
outputDescription: Print the number of even values.

title: Reverse String
description: Read one word and print it reversed.
inputDescription: The first line contains one word without spaces.

title: Count Vowels
description: Read one lowercase word and count vowels a, e, i, o, u.
inputDescription: The first line contains one lowercase word.

title: Palindrome
description: Read one word and print YES if it is a palindrome, otherwise NO.
inputDescription: The first line contains one word.

title: Sort Numbers
description: Read n integers and print them in ascending order.
inputDescription: The first line contains n. The second line contains n integers.
outputDescription: Print the sorted integers separated by spaces.

title: Second Largest
description: Read n distinct integers and print the second largest value.
inputDescription: The first line contains n, where n is at least 2. The second line contains n distinct integers.

title: Factorial
description: Read n and print n factorial.
inputDescription: The first line contains n. 0 <= n <= 12.

title: Prime Check
description: Read n and print PRIME if n is prime, otherwise NOT PRIME.
inputDescription: The first line contains one integer n.

title: GCD
description: Read two positive integers and print their greatest common divisor.
inputDescription: The first line contains two positive integers a and b.

title: Fibonacci
description: Read n and print the nth Fibonacci number. F(0)=0 and F(1)=1.
inputDescription: The first line contains n. 0 <= n <= 45.

title: Linear Search
description: Read n integers and a target x. Print the first zero-based index of x, or -1 if x is not present.
inputDescription: The first line contains n. The second line contains n integers. The third line contains x.
outputDescription: Print the first index of x, or -1.
